notice: Condensed summaries of the conditions in Appendix A of the 2014 Player's Handbook (pp. 290-292), checked against the book. Check the book for exact wording.

conditions.name: Blinded
effects: Automatically fails any ability check that needs sight.
Attack rolls against it have advantage.
Its own attack rolls have disadvantage.

conditions.name: Charmed
effects: Can't attack the charmer or target them with harmful abilities or magical effects.
The charmer has advantage on ability checks to interact socially with it.

conditions.name: Deafened
effects: Automatically fails any ability check that needs hearing.

conditions.name: Frightened
effects: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of its fear is in line of sight.
Can't willingly move closer to the source of its fear.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.summary: Held in place by another creature.
effects: Speed becomes 0 and can't be increased.
Ends if the grappler is incapacitated.
Ends if an effect moves it out of the grappler's reach.

conditions.name: Incapacitated
effects: Can't take actions or reactions.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.summary: Can't be seen without magic or a special sense.
effects: Counts as heavily obscured for the purpose of hiding; its location can still be given away by noise or tracks.
Attack rolls against it have disadvantage.
Its own attack rolls have advantage.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
effects: Incapacitated; can't move or speak.
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against it have advantage.
Any hit from an attacker within 5 feet is a critical hit.

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.summary: Turned to an inanimate substance such as stone.
effects: Incapacitated; can't move or speak and is unaware of its surroundings. Its weight increases tenfold and it stops aging.
Attack rolls against it have advantage.
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Has resistance to all damage.
Immune to poison and disease (any already affecting it is suspended).

conditions.name: Poisoned
effects: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
effects: Can only crawl unless it stands up, which costs half its speed.
Disadvantage on its attack rolls.
Attacks against it have advantage from within 5 feet and disadvantage from farther away.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.summary: Bound, entangled or otherwise held fast.
effects: Speed becomes 0 and can't be increased.
Attack rolls against it have advantage.
Its own attack rolls have disadvantage.
Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.summary: Reeling and barely able to respond.
effects: Incapacitated; can't move and can speak only falteringly.
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against it have advantage.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.summary: Knocked out or asleep and unaware.
effects: Incapacitated; can't move or speak and is unaware of its surroundings.
Drops whatever it is holding and falls prone.
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against it have advantage.
Any hit from an attacker within 5 feet is a critical hit.

exhaustion.name: Exhaustion
exhaustion.summary: Six cumulative levels; each level includes the effects of the lower ones.
levels: Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.
exhaustion.recovery: Finishing a long rest with food and drink reduces exhaustion by one level.
